extracted.intended_audience: attorneys seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; counsel representing such applicants; Office of Enrollment and Discipline practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: Review and decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO under the Office of Enrollment and Discipline—evaluating the petition, an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58, the applicant's bar status in other jurisdictions, and other record information to determine whether reinstatement is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement (submission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Afamefuna Okeke received on August 12, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A formal Petition for Reinstatement must be submitted to the Office of Enrollment and Discipline for consideration; filing the petition is a prerequisite to review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Okeke, through counsel, has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A supporting affidavit filed under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is expected and considered as part of the reinstatement record; the affidavit supplies facts and attestations relevant to eligibility for reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of bar status in other jurisdictions and publicly available information
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, publicly available information regarding his status as an attorney in New York and Texas, and all other information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office considers the applicant's current status and standing in other bars (e.g., New York, Texas) and publicly available records as part of the eligibility determination. Applicants should expect review of comparable records and any information in the administrative record that bears on fitness to practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's discretionary determination to grant reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is granted (or denied) by discretionary determination of the Director based on the submitted petition, affidavit, bar-status information, and other record materials. The Director's decision constitutes the Office's final action on the petition.
